author: retroreviwer
quote: This game is as much a GTA game as my ass is a wind instrument. Absolute watered down, playing it safe, pandering to the masses dog **** i have ever seen. I've seen a lot of game franchises lose their flame over the years but none have had their souls ripped from their cold dead husks quite the GTA has with this newest title. More thought went into the advertisement campaign than the game itself. 2 out of 10 because you can still steal some cars and shoot a gun some places at some of the people sometimes. Also feels like not a single person from the development team has ever been to Florida incredible let down and it wouldve been a bad deal at $60 let alone $100..
